title: How Ukraine Plans to Paralyze Moscow Airports With AI-Guided Drones, According to The Atlantic
key_facts: The Atlantic reported on 15 Oct 2026 that Ukraine is preparing a larger AI-powered drone campaign against Russian aviation, linked to Operation M&Ms.
Moscow airports cancelled 345 flights last week because of Ukrainian drone activity; on 9 Oct all four were briefly closed.
The original proposal envisioned up to 1,000 AI-guided drones daily; they would use map-matching navigation to cope with Russian electronic warfare.
President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has not authorised the more aggressive version, citing civilian safety.
Ukrainian makers are developing specialised drones that have not yet been used against Russian airports at scale.
quote_evidence: Last week, Moscow airports canceled 345 flights due to Ukrainian drone activity.
Zelenskyy has not authorized a more aggressive version of the operation, citing civilian safety concerns.

why_it_matters_hint: A plan to use AI-guided drone swarms against civilian air traffic, not yet approved.
